During your visit, you'll explore campus, connect with current students, and learn how our hands-on STEM programs prepare graduates for meaningful careers. Whether you're early in your college search or narrowing your options, Go to Mines helps you envision yourself here.Upcoming Go to Mines Events There are plenty of iconic duos out there: PB&J, mac-and-cheese, and South Dakota Mines and Minnesota.
